fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck entrance at the S/SE side of the building is a controlled checkpoint - the truck lane has anti-tailgating chevron markings and the yard is enclosed (zoom-19/21 satellite).
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small orange-roofed guard-booth structure sits at the truck-yard entrance on the south side of the building (zoom-19 satellite at ~33.9358,-117.3063), beside the checkpoint lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Large warehouse (~400 m long N-S) with continuous dock-door banks and trailers backed in on BOTH the west and east long faces - 50+ band (1,012,995 sq ft per Racklify).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on two physically separate building faces (east and west).
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailer drop areas along the west face and the south truck court; ~80-100 trailers visible - dropArea 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide truck court at the gate provides room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the dense industrial fabric of Riverside CA (extensive contiguous warehouse cluster) - Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible entering the property.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single shared entry/exit driveway through the guard booth; lane split not resolvable.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly visible; left in uncertainFields.
